image_description: A close-up photograph of a bicycle disc brake assembly. The image features a black Shimano Deore hydraulic caliper mounted on the left side, clamping onto a silver metallic rotor with circular ventilation holes. A black hydraulic hose enters the caliper from the top left. In the background, out of focus, are bicycle spokes and a cassette gear cluster.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Circular metal rotor (disc), notably larger in diameter than its thickness.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor is clearly visible as a thin, circular metal disc. Its diameter significantly exceeds its thickness, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caliper is cast metal mounted over rotor edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black caliper housing is positioned correctly over the outer edge of the rotor to apply braking force.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rotor is mounted to wheel hub with visible lug bolt pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The center of the wheel (hub) is occluded by the caliper body and the angle of the shot; no lug bolts or mounting interface are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rotor is ventilated (two plates with cooling fins) or solid.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor exhibits a pattern of circular cutouts/holes around the perimeter, which serves as ventilation/weight reduction typical for bicycle rotors.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Brake pads are rectangular friction material blocks pressing against rotor faces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The brake pads are internal components housed within the caliper jaws and are not directly visible from this external angle.
A distinct black tube (hydraulic hose) is visible entering the top port of the caliper assembly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface shows machined concentric grooves or cross-drilled holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor surface displays large circular drilled holes for ventilation and heat dissipation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface exhibits heat discoloration (blue/brown tint) from use.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor appears clean and silver/metallic with uniform lighting reflections; there is no evidence of the blue/brown temper colors associated with extreme heat cycling.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caliper is cast aluminum or iron.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The caliper has the smooth, slightly textured finish characteristic of cast or machined aluminum alloy used in bicycle components.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomy of the object as a disk brake and distinguish it from similar mechanical parts.
To verify the physical separation between the caliper and rotor and ensure no melting or fusion artifacts at the contact points.
To audit the legibility and structural correctness of the brand text 'Shimano Deore' visible on the caliper.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle generative noise or blur anomalies.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between caliper and rotor
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text 'Shimano Deore'. AI generators often distort specific brand lettering. Also, check if the hydraulic hose merges naturally into the caliper port or if there is any 'melting' artifact at the connection point. Verify that the rotor holes are consistent in shape and perspective.
